title: Warehouse Sweep
description: Infiltrate the warehouse logistics terminal to pull real-time container delivery timetables and routes.

hints: First digit: I am the only number that is spelled with the same number of letters as my spoken value.
Second digit: I am the number of wheels on a standard unicycle, plus the number of wheels on a standard bicycle.
Third digit: I am the total number of primary colors. Fourth digit: Multiply the second digit by the third digit, then subtract the first digit.

config.instruction: Inventory console cracked. Grab the full supply route manifest, or log a fraudulent kickback fee.
